info.title: QuantumForge API
info.description: Public REST API of the QuantumForge control plane. Worker endpoints are not part of this document.

post.summary: Queue a test execution job for a snapshot (defaults to the latest). Supports the Idempotency-Key header.

get.summary: Fuzz campaigns of a project, newest first

post.summary: Queue a fuzz campaign against a snapshot (defaults to the latest). Supports Idempotency-Key.
post.description: The project's open fuzzing findings are replayed first from their stored reproduction inputs, so a campaign on a fixed snapshot resolves them.

post.summary: Queue a static analysis of a snapshot (defaults to the latest). Supports Idempotency-Key.
